# Typefully

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 1 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Social scheduler marketing: white or charcoal page, blue accent pills, OAuth row, pricing columns, email dialog.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public marketing and the email dialog; the form was not submitted). Themes: light, dark.

Typefully is a social media scheduler (typefully.com). This package covers the public marketing site, the pricing page, and the signed-out email dialog, read on 19 November 2026. Themes are light and dark, switched with `prefers-color-scheme`. Widths are 1440 and 390. Nothing was submitted. Google, X/Twitter and LinkedIn were not clicked.

## Colors

The roles below are the catalog's swatches for the `light` theme. The front matter then lists every colour token under `light`, named by its path with dots turned into hyphens.

- **primary (#199AF5):** `light.action.accent`
- **neutral (#FFFFFF):** `light.background.page`
- **surface (#FCFCFD):** `light.background.surface`
- **on-surface (#000000):** `light.text.primary`
- **on-surface-variant (#5C6D7A):** `light.text.muted`
- **outline (#E6E8EA):** `light.border.default`

## Typography

12 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Inter.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Inter is the computed face on the page, the headings and the buttons. The stack continues with system-ui, Helvetica Neue and Segoe UI. The files are not committed.

inter-arrows-subset is the computed face on tweet handles inside the public demo (`--font-twitter`), then GT America. Neither file is here.

Fira Code is declared as `--font-code`. No code specimen was measured.

Spacing from `core.spacing`: `1` 4px, `2` 8px, `3` 12px, `4` 16px, `5` 20px, `8` 32px.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The marketing page follows the OS colour scheme. Tokens in `light` and `dark` are the painted surfaces under each scheme. A class of `dark-mode` on `html` was not set by hand.

OAuth borders and the Log in border are `oklab()` colours. The tokens store the nearest opaque hex from the role they match (`--c6`, `--c3`). The computed oklab strings are in [raw/components-computed.json](raw/components-computed.json).

The focus ring is a 20% oklab mix of the accent, painted as a 4px shadow. `border.focus` stores the accent at 20% alpha (`#199AF533`). That is a flattening, not the mix the browser computed.

The dark email field and the dark dialog were not opened. Those two dark component tokens reuse the dark surface colour and are marked Derived.

The 256-colour screenshots band the hero gradient and the product demo. Read colour from the tokens.

Inter, inter-arrows-subset, GT America and Fira Code are not in this package. The style guide falls back to the system sans.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Primary actions are the blue pill.** Sign up, Continue and the Business Get started button use `#199AF5` with white type. [components/crops/button-primary-default.png](components/crops/button-primary-default.png)
- **Secondary actions are a quiet button.** Log in is a hairline outline. Get started on Free and Creator is a white button with a grey border. [components/crops/button-nav-default.png](components/crops/button-nav-default.png)
- **OAuth choices sit in a row of pills.** Google, X/Twitter, LinkedIn and Email share one height and one radius. [screenshots/home-light-default.png](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **The page follows the OS scheme.** Light is white. Dark is `#111418`. [screenshots/home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png)
- **Headings are Inter at 700.** The hero is 44px. Section headings are 36px. Plan names are 18px at 600. [screenshots/pricing-light-default.png](screenshots/pricing-light-default.png)

### Gaps (from README.md)

- Signed-in app, queues, composer, analytics and settings were not entered.
- Google, X/Twitter and LinkedIn were not clicked. The email form was not submitted. A Cloudflare Turnstile widget was present on the form, so a code was not requested.
- `/login` is a public 404. There is no separate login URL in this capture.
- Hover, pressed, disabled, loading and error states were not forced.
- The billing switch off state was not captured.
- The dark email dialog was not opened.
- Inline icons were not extracted.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` was not emulated.
